description_ko: 과부하 천칭의 사슬이 손목·발목을 당겨 성상을 공중에 매단다. 열린 갈비 외피와 태엽 심장, 길게 찢긴 예복이 처형 도구 같은 형태를 만든다.

references.role: normal Justitia identity, hair, slender feminine judicial statue, original sword, robe and scale
hard transformation through shell opening, clockwork exposure and ominous articulated posture
structural mechanical shell opening and clean rendering, not bell body or insect legs

visual_qa.subject: One feminine humanoid hero with familiar curled ivory hair, split gold blindfold gaze, navy high collar, starred judicial robe, one original sword and two balance pans.
visual_qa.transformation: Wide overloaded tilted balance with two winches. Both wrists and ankles visibly chained. Suspended unequal-height feet, mechanically opened torso and exposed brass spiral spine / heart create large pose and structure difference from normal.
visual_qa.anatomy_and_framing: Two arms, two legs, two hands gripping sword, exactly two pans. Entire beam, loaded pan, empty pan, coat tails, sword and feet in frame. Top beam close to upper margin but not cut.
visual_qa.style: Polished ivory/navy/brass 2D cel concept with lavender shadows and clean pale background.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view concept candidate; not selected, not a validated 3D rig.
